Name: Greenhouse Double Doors
Author: Zonderion
Description:
This provides a double door for both inside and outside. The interior warp points work as expected, however the exterior warp points I couldn't get to work. You will need to be centered (where the original door is) in order to enter the Greenhouse. If anyone has experience with adding warp points to the farm, I would greatly appreciate the help!
